f009c3440150dbcb.description: Job description Responsibilities: ﻿ Patient Communication and Identification Follow JHAH policies and established procedures for positive patient identification. Sample and Tube Requirements Know the required blood volume for each test and collect sufficient samples to avoid QNS (Quantity Not Sufficient). Identify the correct tube type and transport conditions for all tests, including referral tests. Prioritize STAT samples over routine orders. Pediatric Venipuncture Perform blood collection on pediatric patients while maintaining high standards of patient care. Demonstrate empathy and compassion toward patients and their relatives. Finger Stick / Heel Stick Safely use lancets and Tenderfoot devices for neonates and infants. Select the appropriate puncture site according to established procedures. Blood Culture Collection Follow international aseptic techniques to minimize contamination and avoid repeat testing. Adverse Reactions Assess patients for signs of fear or unease and explain the blood collection procedure to reassure them. Check for allergies or sensitivities to materials, including sensitivity to the sight of blood or needles. Follow the appropriate procedures in the event of an unexpected adverse reaction. Laboratory Information System (LIS) and Hospital Information System (HIS) Demonstrate proficiency in using LIS and HIS. Understand the procedures and workflows required to manage collection area activities accurately and ensure error-free processing. Non-Blood Sample Processing Issue sample containers, release test orders, and accession non-blood samples. Laboratory Safety Strictly follow all safety policies relating to fire safety, infection control, Hazard Communication (HazCom), and Basic Life Support (BLS). Identify and properly use all personal protective equipment (PPE) required in the laboratory. Professional Attitude Maintain punctuality at work. Comply with the dress code policy. Demonstrate enthusiasm and dedication to the job. Skills SCHS Registration Maintain a valid license and SCHS registration. Renew the license and registration on time to prevent expiry during employment. Mandatory Training Complete all JHAH mandatory training and specified LSD-required courses on time, without delay. Candidate Criteria Follow regulations for patient identification using two identifiers. Have a minimum of one year of experience in venipuncture and capillary blood collection techniques. Demonstrate knowledge of the order of draw and specimen requirements. Demonstrate knowledge of specimen labeling, handling, and transportation. Demonstrate knowledge of infection prevention, hand hygiene, and sharps safety. Demonstrate knowledge of patient communication and procedure explanation. Demonstrate patient-centered care, empathy, professionalism, and customer service. Be flexible to work rotating shifts, weekends, and holidays, and adapt to operational needs.

f0f3f613365e7f81.job_title: H-60 Helicopter Engine Drivetrain Mechanic/Aviation Machinist Mate-1
f0f3f613365e7f81.description: Will perform Field and Sustainment Level maintenance support/augmentation to include: Production control, Quality Control, Supply Management, maintenance, and repair of aircraft. Position requires a skilled Engine / Drivetrain Mechanic with the ability to perform Intermediate Maintenance Periodicity requirements on MH-60R helicopters. Organizational, Intermediate, and Depot level skills are desired to inspect, repair, and fabricate propulsion and drive chain components. Also requires inspection and repair of flight control components and systems. Shall work in specialized shops associated with fixed base operations Field Level maintenance as well as perform troubleshooting, testing, maintenance repairs and Technical Directive compliance on the H-60 Airframe in Saudi Arabia . Essential Responsibilities: Current or previous experience performing complex helicopter mechanical work to include but not limited to: Perform maintenance and repair of major assemblies, subassemblies and line replaceable unit's (LRUs) of the MH-60R power plant related systems (engines and auxiliary power units). Along with fuel cell maintenance, tail rotor breakdown and rigging, and tail drive shaft removal and shimming. Has a in-depth knowledge of the IMDS/HUMS vibration diagnostic system. Can use IVHMU data and the HUMS ground station to make adjustments to bring in vibration diagnostics to the minimum standards. Remove, disassemble, repair, rig, rework, reassemble, install, modify, adjust, test and preserve power plant systems, transmission systems, tail drive shaft assembly, rotor systems, fuel cells, flight controls, subsystems, and components according to directives, technical manuals, and safety procedures. Perform inspection, troubleshooting, fault detection, fault isolation, and appropriate AVUM/AVIM corrective actions on the power plant related systems, transmission systems, tail drive shaft assembly, rotor system, fuel systems, and oil systems. Perform depot-level maintenance and repair when authorized. Perform power plant depot-level maintenance and repair when authorized. Operate and maintain all applicable peculiar and common ground support equipment. Identify, use and maintain all common, special, and precision tools available for power plant maintenance and repair. Responsible for completion and maintenance of applicable forms, records, and reports using appropriate references and other publications including the NAMP. Provide On-the-Job-Training (OJT) for Saudi technicians and/or other personnel to include maintaining appropriate records on personnel such as Readiness Insight, ASMi, or an ASMi substitute. Assist in shop safety as well as safety in the hangar and on the flight line. Accept accountability of property for the Power Plant Shop. Maintain cleanliness and general maintenance of the associated work area. Perform cleaning, preservation, and operational maintenance work on assigned vehicles, tools, and equipment. Operate motor vehicles, machines, and other mechanical equipment in the performance of assigned duties. Minimum Position Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Required: 8 years current or previous experience performing complex helicopter mechanical work, and verifiable experience maintaining H-60 aircraft. A valid A&P license , QAR, CDQAR, or TI qualification is required. High School Diploma or equivalent Clearance Requirement: Must be able to obtain and maintain a NAC(T3) Background Investigation and drug test. Must be able to obtain and maintain facility credentials/authorization. May be required to obtain and maintain a secret clearance. We maintain a drug-free workplace and perform post offer, pre-employment substance abuse testing.

f0320f4360828a9c.job_title: Technical Project Manager - Smart City, Ai
f0320f4360828a9c.description: Job description About the job TECHNICAL PROJECT MANAGER - SMART CITY, AI Duncan & Ross is hiring Technical Project Managers to deliver smart city, AI and networking programmes for Saudi Arabia's giga-projects and destination developers. You'll own technology delivery end to end, from design and procurement through integration, testing and handover, on some of the most ambitious builds in the region. What you'll do Lead the end-to-end delivery of smart city and smart destination technology projects, such as IoT and sensor networks, command and control centres, smart mobility, CCTV and video analytics, and smart building systems. Deliver AI and data projects, including computer vision, footfall and crowd analytics, predictive maintenance and digital twins, from proof of concept to live operation. Manage the rollout of active and passive network infrastructure: fibre backbone, data centres, LAN/WAN, Wi-Fi, 5G/LTE, ELV and telecom systems. Coordinate with master planners, design consultants, MEP and construction contractors so technology is integrated into the build programme at the right stage. Run vendor and systems-integrator selection, from RFPs and technical evaluation to contract award, and manage delivery against SLAs and milestones. Own scope, schedule, budget, risks and dependencies, and report progress to steering committees and executive stakeholders. Oversee system integration, testing (FAT, SAT, UAT), commissioning, operational readiness and handover to operations. Ensure delivery meets client standards and Saudi regulations, including cybersecurity (NCA) and data-protection requirements. What you'll bring PMP certification. 8+ years managing technology projects, including at least 3 on smart city, smart destination, giga-project or large infrastructure programmes. Smart city: delivery of IoT platforms, integrated command centres, smart mobility, security and surveillance, or building management systems. AI and data: delivery of AI-enabled solutions such as computer vision, video analytics, predictive analytics or digital twins, and a working understanding of data platforms and AI governance. Networking: solid technical grounding in network infrastructure: fibre and structured cabling, LAN/WAN, Wi-Fi, data centres and telecom systems. Experience managing systems integrators, OEMs and multi-vendor delivery against contracts and SLAs. Experience working with construction, MEP and design teams on new-build developments. Strong governance, reporting and stakeholder-management skills, including at executive and board level. Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related field. Fluent written and spoken English. Nice to have Arabic, spoken and written (strongly preferred). Previous work on Saudi giga-projects or other large destination, entertainment or tourism developments. Theme park, leisure or hospitality technology experience, for example ticketing, guest experience or park operations systems. Additional certifications such as PRINCE2, PgMP, Agile/Scrum, ITIL or CCNA/CCNP. Familiarity with Saudi NCA cybersecurity controls and data-protection regulations. ﻿ Vertical: Technology Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

f030f58265e8f244.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن شركة الرويس عن حاجتها لمدير عمليات تشغيل (Chief Operating Officer) للانضمام إلى فريقها في شرورة، نجران. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة الإشراف المباشر على فريق التشغيل والصيانة في موقع العمل بمنطقة الربع الخالي، وقيادة أعمال التشغيل اليومية ومتابعة تنفيذها وفق الخطط والإجراءات المعتمدة، مع ضمان جودة الأداء واستمرارية الخدمات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف المباشر على أعضاء فريق التشغيل والصيانة ومتابعة تنفيذ المهام اليومية. توزيع الأعمال والمهام على أفراد الفريق وفق الأولويات واحتياجات الموقع. متابعة أعمال التشغيل والصيانة، بما في ذلك الصيانة الوقائية والتصحيحية، والتأكد من إنجازها في الوقت المحدد. رصد الأعطال والملاحظات التشغيلية والفنية ورفعها للمشرف العام، ومتابعة معالجتها والتأكد من إغلاقها. إجراء الجولات الميدانية ومتابعة حالة المرافق والمعدات ضمن نطاق المسؤولية. التأكد من التزام أفراد الفريق بتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية. متابعة الالتزام بأوقات العمل والحضور والانصراف ورفع أي ملاحظات للجهة المختصة. التنسيق مع فرق التشغيل والصيانة الأخرى عند الحاجة لضمان استمرارية العمل. متابعة استخدام الأدوات والمعدات ومواد الصيانة والمحافظة عليها، والتأكد من المحافظة على مرافق الموقع وممتلكاته. إعداد ورفع التقارير اليومية أو الدورية عن الأعمال المنجزة والملاحظات والأعطال. الإبلاغ الفوري عن الحالات الطارئة أو الأعطال التي قد تؤثر على استمرارية التشغيل. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الشركة والتعليمات المعتمدة بالموقع. تنفيذ أي مهام أخرى ذات صلة يتم التكليف بها من المسؤول المباشر. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال ذي صلة بالتشغيل والصيانة. القدرة على قيادة وإدارة فرق العمل بفعالية. فهم عميق لإجراءات التشغيل والصيانة ومعايير الجودة. متطلبات العمل القدرة على معالجة الملاحظات التشغيلية ورفع التقارير اللازمة للجهة المشرفة. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والصحة المهنية. مهارات تواصل ممتازة وقدرة على التنسيق مع الأطراف المختلفة. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

Pre-register designated guests and prepare key packets. Organize and coordinate check-in/pre-registration procedures for arriving groups. Review, track, and accommodate requests for room/check-out changes, communicating status to relevant staff. Confirm reservations and process cancellations. Lead technical reviews and provide SME input during design/model reviews, HAZOPs, and client meetings. Mentor piping stress engineers and perform technical/quality reviews of engineering deliverables. Support resolution of technical queries, deviations, site issues, and engineering optimization related to piping dynamic stress. f024e212bb4ccaec.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث إمكان الطبية عن فني هندسة ميكانيكية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور إلى دعم أنشطة الهندسة الميكانيكية، بما في ذلك التصميم والإنتاج والتركيب والصيانة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المساعدة في أبحاث الهندسة الميكانيكية وتصميم المعدات والنظم. دعم أنشطة الإنتاج والتركيب والصيانة. المساهمة في وضع نظريات جديدة وتحسين الأساليب الحالية في المجال. تقديم المشورة بشأن المواد ومعايير الجودة ضمن عملية التصميم. الإشراف على تنفيذ العمليات وتركيب النظم، وإعداد الجداول الزمنية وتقديرات التكلفة للمشاريع الهندسية. تقديم الدعم في أعمال صيانة النظم وتصليحها. اتباع سياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية أو ما يعادله. القدرة على المساعدة في أبحاث وتصميم المعدات والنظم الميكانيكية. فهم جيد لعمليات الإنتاج والتركيب والصيانة. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات تحليلية وحل المشكلات. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق وتقديم الدعم الفني. الالتزام بمعايير الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض. سيعمل شاغل الوظيفة ضمن فريق متخصص لدعم العمليات الهندسية في إمكان الطبية. تقديم الطلبات لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب لهذا الدور. ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم.

f07a4836f356a353.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة تكامل المرافق للتشغيل والصيانة عن فني تدفئة وتهوية وتكييف للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تركيب وصيانة وإصلاح معدات التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية، بما في ذلك وحدات التدفئة ومضخاتها ومكيفات الهواء. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المساهمة في عملية تصميم نظم التهوية وتكييف الهواء والتدفئة بشكل كامل، وتقديم المشورة بشأن المواد ومعايير الجودة. تقديم الدعم للمشروعات الهندسية، ومباشرة تنفيذ العمليات وتركيب النظم، ووضع جداول زمنية وتقديرات التكلفة. تقديم الدعم في أعمال الصيانة وتصليح النظم. مراقبة الجوانب الفنية المتصلة بإنتاج وتركيب واستعمال وصيانة منظومات وأجهزة ومعدات التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف، للتأكد من دقة الأداء ومطابقة المواصفات. اتباع سياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء (HVAC). القدرة على تركيب وصيانة وإصلاح مختلف أنواع معدات التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية. فهم جيد لمعايير الجودة وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. موقع العمل ونوعه يقع مقر هذا الدور في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية، وهو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة تكامل المرافق للتشغيل والصيانة. تقديم الطلبات نحن ندعو المرشحين المؤهلين لتقديم طلباتهم لهذا الدور في الرياض.

f0cb6140019a42fc.company_name: شركة هشام عبدالحق البلوشي للصناعات الغذائية
f0cb6140019a42fc.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اتحاد الخدمات المساندة للمقاولات عن أخصائي تسويق للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات، وسيكون شاغل الوظيفة مسؤولاً عن تطوير وتنفيذ الاستراتيجيات التسويقية لمنتجات الشركة وخدماتها. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تحديد الأهداف التسويقية العامة والفرعية، وتطوير السياسات والخطط والبرامج التسويقية. تحليل دورة حياة المنتج لتحديد عوامل النجاح أو الفشل التسويقي، وتحليل أسعار المنافسين، وتطوير سياسات التسعير. تحديد برامج الترويج، واختيار قنوات التوزيع المناسبة، وتقييم فعالية الحملات الدعائية والإعلانية. وضع جدول زمني لتنفيذ السياسات التسويقية، ومتابعة إجراءات التنفيذ، وتقييم النتائج المحققة. إجراء اختبارات للمنتجات الجديدة قبل طرحها في الأسواق باستخدام برامج حاسوبية متخصصة في اختبارات السوق، وذلك وفقاً لمتطلبات العمل. إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة المتعلقة بالتسويق، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال التسويق. فهم عميق لمبادئ التسويق وتحليل السوق. القدرة على استخدام برامج حاسوبية متخصصة في اختبارات السوق. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية لتحديد اتجاهات السوق وتقييم الأداء التسويقي. القدرة على تطوير وتنفيذ الخطط التسويقية بفعالية. مهارات تواصل ممتازة لتقديم التقارير والتوصيات. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق وفي بيئة عمل ديناميكية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض. سيعمل أخصائي التسويق ضمن فريق متخصص يساهم في تحقيق الأهداف التسويقية للشركة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

f0a2b9d656ded119.description: نبحث عن بائع كشك متحمس للانضمام إلى فريقنا، حيث ستكون مسؤولاً عن تقديم تجربة ممتازة للعملاء وإدارة العمليات اليومية للكشك. تتضمن مهامك الأساسية خدمة العملاء، ترتيب المنتجات، والحفاظ على نظافة وترتيب المكان. إذا كنت تمتلك مهارات تواصل جيدة وشغفاً بالعمل، فإن هذه الفرصة مناسبة لك. مهام ومسؤوليات الوظيفة: * استقبال العملاء والترحيب بهم بابتسامة وود. * تقديم معلومات وافية عن المنتجات المتاحة والإجابة على استفسارات العملاء. * إتمام عمليات البيع بفعالية ودقة، بما في ذلك التعامل مع النقد والمدفوعات الإلكترونية. * الحفاظ على ترتيب ونظافة الكشك وعرض المنتجات بشكل جذاب. * إدارة المخزون وتنبيه المسؤول عند الحاجة لإعادة التعبئة. * الالتزام بسياسات الشركة وإجراءاتها المتعلقة بالخدمة والتعامل مع العملاء.

f06886bf93653541.description: موظف/موظفة استقبال فندقي يعلن أحد الفنادق عن توفر فرصة وظيفية لشغل منصب موظف/موظفة استقبال فندقي. نبحث عن شخص يتمتع بمهارات تواصل ممتازة وشخصية ودودة ليكون واجهة الفندق، ويساهم في تقديم تجربة ضيافة مميزة للنزلاء. المهام والمسؤوليات * استقبال النزلاء والترحيب بهم وتقديم تجربة ضيافة مميزة. * تنفيذ إجراءات تسجيل الدخول والمغادرة بكفاءة واحترافية. * الرد على استفسارات العملاء وتقديم الدعم والمساعدة اللازمة. * إدارة حجوزات الغرف، بما في ذلك التأكيد والتعديل والإلغاء. * التعامل مع المدفوعات وإصدار الفواتير بدقة. * حل شكاوى النزلاء بفعالية وتقديم الحلول المناسبة. * التنسيق مع مختلف أقسام الفندق لضمان جودة الخدمة ورضا النزلاء. المتطلبات * حسن المظهر واللباقة في التعامل. * مهارات تواصل وخدمة عملاء متميزة. * إجادة استخدام الحاسب الآلي. * القدرة على العمل بنظام المناوبات. * الالتزام والانضباط في العمل. الشرط الأساسي خبرة لا تقل عن سنة واحدة في الاستقبال الفندقي وبرامج الحجز الفندقية مثل: ******** – Expedia – Agoda – زائر. تفاصيل الوظيفة * الراتب: 4000 ريال شهريًا. * ساعات العمل: 8 ساعات يوميًا. * أيام العمل: 6 أيام أسبوعيًا. * يوم راحة أسبوعي. * العمل بنظام المناوبات. نتطلع إلى انضمام كفاءات متميزة تسهم في تقديم أفضل الخدمات لضيوف الفندق.

f03e79b02cc88e7c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركه منبع التصافي عن مشرف صيانة للانضمام إلى فريقها في سكاكا، الجوف. يهدف هذا الدور إلى الإشراف على جميع جوانب الصيانة، بما في ذلك إعداد الخطط والبرامج، وتوزيع المهام، وتقييم الأداء، وتطوير برامج الصيانة الوقائية لضمان استمرارية العمليات بكفاءة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد خطة وبرنامج العمل الخاص بالصيانة ومتابعة تنفيذهما. متابعة إجراءات تحديد نوع وطبيعة الصيانة المطلوبة وتقدير كمية وتكلفة المواد اللازمة. توزيع المهام والواجبات على أعضاء فريق الصيانة بناءً على إمكاناتهم وقدراتهم. متابعة وتقييم أداء فريق الصيانة وتقييم إنجازاتهم بشكل دوري. تقييم الاحتياجات التدريبية لفرق الصيانة وتصميم البرامج التدريبية اللازمة لتنمية مهاراتهم، أو التوصية بإلحاقهم ببرامج تدريبية متخصصة. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية ومتابعة إجراءات تنفيذها لضمان استمرارية العمليات. تصنيف وترتيب وتوثيق وحفظ النتائج وتقارير العمل المتعلقة بأنشطة الصيانة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال الصيانة أو دور إشرافي ذي صلة. القدرة على إعداد الخطط والبرامج ومتابعة تنفيذها. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في التخطيط والتنظيم. القدرة على قيادة وتوجيه فريق العمل. مهارات تقييم الأداء وتحديد الاحتياجات التدريبية. القدرة على إعداد التقارير وتوثيق المعلومات بدقة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة سكاكا بمنطقة الجوف. ستعمل ضمن فريق متخصص في بيئة عمل ديناميكية تتطلب الالتزام والكفاءة في إدارة عمليات الصيانة. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة الشخصية. نشجع المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه على التقديم.

f09f43b3ef077210.description: About the Role Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking an experienced and talented Manager - Design to join its team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves leading the design and development of innovative projects, ensuring they meet high standards of quality, functionality, and aesthetics. The Design Manager will oversee multidisciplinary design teams and collaborate with key stakeholders to deliver projects from concept through completion. Role Overview The ideal candidate is a creative leader with strong technical expertise and project management capabilities. This position requires a professional who can ensure successful project delivery while maintaining alignment with project objectives and industry best practices. The role is based in Riyadh Province and requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Lead and manage a team of architects and designers, providing direction, mentorship, and technical guidance. Oversee the development of design concepts, plans, and specifications, ensuring alignment with project objectives. Collaborate with internal departments, consultants, and external stakeholders to define project requirements and deliver integrated design solutions. Manage the full design lifecycle from concept development through project completion, ensuring adherence to scope, budget, schedule, and quality standards. Review and approve design proposals, drawings, and technical documentation to ensure compliance with project goals and industry best practices. Coordinate with contractors, consultants, and suppliers to support efficient project execution. Stay informed about emerging design trends, technologies, and industry innovations, incorporating best practices where appropriate. Ensure compliance with applicable regulations, design codes, and company standards. Foster a culture of collaboration, creativity, continuous improvement, and professional development within the design team. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in design management or a related field. Demonstrated leadership experience in overseeing multidisciplinary design teams. Strong technical expertise in design principles and project delivery. Exceptional project management capabilities. A passion for design excellence and innovation. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working within a collaborative environment, engaging with various internal departments and external stakeholders to achieve project goals.

f0a204551dd54d46.description: About the Role eXtra is seeking a Team Leader - Ops to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role focuses on supporting store performance through effective sales leadership, ensuring customer satisfaction, and fostering a motivated sales team. f0b1d3bf89fc395b.description: كاشير/باريستا ضمان تجربة عملاء ممتازة من خلال إدارة عمليات النقد بكفاءة وإعداد مشروبات القهوة عالية الجودة. المسؤوليات الأساسية: إعداد جميع أنواع مشروبات الإسبريسو والقهوة (الساخنة والباردة) وفقاً للمعايير المحددة. استقبال طلبات العملاء بترحيب وتسجيلها بدقة. إدارة جميع المعاملات النقدية. الحفاظ على نظافة منطقة العمل والمعدات والالتزام بمعايير الصحة والسلامة. القدرة على العمل بفعالية تحت ضغط وفي أوقات الذروة.

f0f7f814e73e0749.description: About the Role Compass Project Consulting is seeking a Senior Commercial Manager to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position involves leading commercial functions and providing strategic advice to senior stakeholders, ensuring robust financial management and contractual compliance for projects. Key Responsibilities Lead budget control, cost planning, procurement strategy development, tender evaluation, and contract packaging. Manage cost reports, cash flow forecasts, change registers, risk allowances, and cost-to-complete analyses. Strong understanding of contract law, procurement, and cost control principles. f019fc810beccbc8.description: About the Role Parsons Corporation is seeking an Excellence Director to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position involves senior-level management, strategic, and supervisory responsibilities for excellence activities within a major program. The role focuses on ensuring that products and services align with both customer and Parsons' excellence requirements, encompassing quality, continuous improvement, risk management, training, and knowledge transfer. Strategic Leadership in Excellence The Excellence Director provides strategic leadership in the development and implementation of Quality systems, procedures, and related excellence activities. This position requires regular interaction with executive and senior-level representatives across various business functions, including leadership, program/project management, safety, design/engineering, contracts, procurement, and construction personnel. Key Responsibilities Participate in the interview and selection process, including hiring recommendations, and make staffing assignments. Conduct performance evaluations and recommend actions such as advancement, changes in status, or disciplinary measures. Manage the salary administration process, including preparing annual salary plans and recommending merit increases or promotions. Provide Quality Systems leadership, utilizing the Parsons Quality Management System for process development, optimization, procedure development, data collection, reporting, and training. Direct and facilitate efforts to maintain Parsons Excellence-related certifications. Interface at senior and executive levels regarding performance improvement initiatives. Collaborate with Excellence representatives in business units to facilitate Quality and Risk training programs, achieve objectives, set future goals, and coordinate Management Review outputs. Direct and facilitate the continuous improvement of the program Quality Management System and the culture of Quality at Parsons. Provide leadership, guidance, and training to both Parsons and Client personnel, monitoring performance and identifying necessary skills and capabilities. Act as a liaison with programs/projects, customers, contractors, and internal departments on quality-related matters and staffing. Guide and advance the overall performance of quality at Parsons. Identify and report excellence issues or trends to executive management based on diverse data sources. Provide input to management on organizational performance metrics and process or procedural system improvements. Qualifications and Experience Over 10 years of relevant experience in excellence activities, including quality, continuous improvement, risk, training, and knowledge transfer. Demonstrated ability to provide strategic leadership in the development and implementation of Quality systems and procedures. Experience interacting with executive and senior-level stakeholders. Reporting Structure and Contacts The Excellence Director reports to the Vice President, Quality, and Executive Management. This role involves supervision of Quality, Risk, and Training Personnel. Internal contacts include all employees on projects or within Corporate functions, while external contacts primarily involve customer personnel. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply.

f031a1194f2043a2.job_title: Tendering Manager OHTL & Underground Cable (UGC) Projects
f031a1194f2043a2.description: About the Role Nesma Al Riyadh Contracting Company is seeking an experienced Tendering Manager – OHTL & Underground Cable (UGC) Projects to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves leading the preparation, coordination, and submission of competitive and technically compliant tenders for Overhead Transmission Lines (OHTL) and Underground Cable (UGC) projects within Saudi Arabia. The successful candidate will have over 10 years of experience in EPC power transmission projects and a strong understanding of the Saudi power transmission market. Key Responsibilities Lead the complete tendering process from receipt of ITT/RFP documents through final bid submission and clarification stages. Develop and manage the overall tender strategy, bid plan, schedule, and submission requirements. Coordinate with engineering teams to develop technically compliant proposals for OHTL, UGC, substations, and associated transmission works. Coordinate with procurement, suppliers, and subcontractors to obtain competitive quotations. Lead the preparation of detailed EPC cost estimates and tender pricing, analyzing project quantities, construction methodology, and resource requirements. Review contractual terms and conditions, identifying commercial and contractual risks, qualifications, and deviations. Coordinate with clients, consultants, utilities, and EPC partners during the tender stage, managing clarifications and participating in pre-bid meetings. Maintain strong knowledge of the Saudi power transmission and EPC market, including SEC requirements and local content expectations. Lead and coordinate multidisciplinary tender teams, assigning responsibilities and ensuring timely completion of deliverables. Estimation and Pricing Focus This role requires expertise in developing pricing for major OHTL and UGC components. This includes conductors, OPGW, towers, steel structures, foundations, insulators, fittings, earthing systems, cable systems and accessories, cable installation and jointing, cable trenching/duct banks, civil works, testing and commissioning, and transportation and logistics. The Tendering Manager will also prepare cost comparisons, price benchmarking, and commercial analyses, identifying opportunities for cost optimization. Contractual and Commercial Review The Tendering Manager will be responsible for reviewing contractual terms and conditions such as scope of work, payment terms, liquidated damages, performance guarantees, retention, advance payment, bonds, warranty requirements, delay provisions, variation/change mechanisms, insurance requirements, taxes, and duties. This includes identifying commercial and contractual risks, preparing tender risk registers, and recommending mitigation measures in coordination with legal and commercial teams. Qualifications and Experience Minimum of 10 years of experience in power transmission EPC, specifically in tendering/proposals. Strong technical understanding of OHTL and UGC systems. Demonstrated experience in tender strategy, techno-commercial estimation, bid management, and contract requirements. Proven experience in the Saudi power transmission market, including projects involving Saudi Electricity Company (SEC) and other major utilities, developers, and EPC stakeholders. Ability to independently lead complex, high-value tenders. Strong coordination skills with engineering, procurement, construction, finance, commercial, supplier, subcontractor, and senior management teams. f0af3ad44a21e89d.description: About the Role Tabby is seeking a Lead Anti-Fraud Officer to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves independently leading complex governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) activities, serving as a subject matter expert in areas such as enterprise information security governance, risk management frameworks, regulatory compliance, or third-party risk management. The Lead Anti-Fraud Officer will produce high-quality GRC deliverables, mentor junior and mid-level team members, and contribute to the continuous improvement of the organization's GRC framework, risk treatment processes, and compliance reporting mechanisms. This position acts as a liaison between technical execution and program leadership, collaborating with leads, legal, audit, and business stakeholders to achieve mature GRC outcomes aligned with the Saudi Fintech regulatory environment. Key Responsibilities Lead the development, review, and continuous improvement of information security policies, standards, procedures, and governance frameworks. Serve as the subject matter expert for assigned regulatory domains, interpreting requirements and translating them into implementable control objectives. Monitor regulatory and legal developments affecting information security, assessing impact, and recommending updates to the governance framework. Prepare and review governance documentation, including RACI matrices, security charter updates, and governance committee packs, presenting findings to senior stakeholders. Lead the preparation of regulatory self-assessments and compliance attestations, coordinating evidence gathering and quality-reviewing submissions. Mentor GR1–GR2 team members on governance documentation quality, regulatory interpretation, and risk assessment methodology. Enterprise Risk Management Lead complex enterprise information security risk assessments, applying advanced methodologies to produce risk profiles aligned with the organization's risk appetite. Maintain the enterprise information security risk register, ensuring accuracy, currency, and appropriate escalation of significant risks. Lead Business Impact Analysis (BIA) processes for critical business functions, coordinating with asset owners and analyzing recovery requirements. Design and execute control effectiveness testing programs, producing findings reports with gap analysis and risk-ranked remediation recommendations. Lead third-party information security risk management, designing assessment frameworks, conducting vendor reviews, and maintaining the third-party risk register. Produce executive-quality risk reporting with trend analysis, emerging risk identification, and treatment progress tracking. Compliance Program Delivery Lead compliance monitoring activities for CFFR, NCA ECC, PDPL, ISO 27001, and PCI-DSS, producing gap analyses, treatment plans, and periodic status reports. Manage internal and external audit cycles, coordinating evidence collection, reviewing quality, engaging with auditors, and tracking remediation. Design and deliver the security awareness program, producing targeted content, conducting awareness sessions, and analyzing effectiveness metrics. Develop and maintain GRC program metrics dashboards, ensuring KPIs and KRIs are accurately measured and presented. Lead the integration of information security requirements into third-party contracts, procurement processes, and major project onboarding. Contribute to the information security program strategy, identifying capability improvement opportunities and recommending investment priorities. Cross-Functional Collaboration and Knowledge Leadership Serve as the primary GRC point of contact for assigned business and technology teams, providing expert guidance on security requirements, risk treatment, and compliance obligations. Lead information classification and security requirements reviews for significant IT, product, and business projects. Contribute to the GRC knowledge base, developing reusable templates, guidance documents, and training materials for internal use. Represent the GRC function in cross-functional working groups, project steering committees, and regulatory workstreams. Perform additional responsibilities as assigned by management. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in governance, risk, and compliance within information security. The role requires a strong understanding of GRC domains and the ability to lead complex activities independently.

f0d724dc580ab6d6.job_title: Food Hall Food Safety & HSE Manager
f0d724dc580ab6d6.description: POSITION OVERVIEW: The Health, Safety & Environment (HSE) Manager is responsible for ensuring that all health, safety, hygiene, sanitation, and environmental standards are implemented and maintained across the food hall operations. The role oversees stewarding operations, food safety compliance, sanitation standards, waste management, and maintenance coordination to ensure a safe, clean, and compliant environment for tenants, staff, and guests. The HSE Manager works closely with the Operations Manager, Venue Manager and external service providers to ensure compliance with food safety regulations, sanitation protocols, environmental standards, and operational safety requirements. CORE RESPONSIBILITIES: 1. Health, Safety & Compliance • Ensure full compliance with health, safety, sanitation, and environmental regulations in accordance with local authorities and company policies. • Develop and implement a comprehensive HACCP management system. • Conduct daily / weekly inspections and audits to identify potential safety risks, hygiene issues, or maintenance requirements. • Ensure the dishwashing and stewarding areas follow sanitation and safety protocols at all times. • Monitor food hall pods to ensure food safety standards and cleanliness requirements are followed by tenants. • Provide food safety support and audits in collaboration of TR manager. • Report any safety concerns, hazards, or non-compliance issues to management and coordinate corrective actions. 2. Stewarding & Sanitation Operations • Supervise and coordinate the daily operations of the stewarding team to ensure efficient cleaning and sanitation processes. • Monitor dishwashing procedures to ensure proper cleaning, sanitizing, and storage of all tableware, utensils, and kitchen equipment. • Maintain cleanliness and sanitation of kitchens, dining areas, storage areas, dishwashing stations, and service areas. • Ensure proper waste disposal and recycling procedures in compliance with environmental regulations. • Ensure the cleanliness of guest facilities including restrooms and public areas. • Maintain high standards of cleanliness in outdoor terrace areas and public spaces. 3. Inventory & Resource Management • Manage AMSD inventory including cleaning chemicals, supplies, disposables, and equipment ensuring adequate stock levels. • Coordinate with the Ops Manager / Purchasing department for ordering cleaning materials and operational supplies. • Monitor and report inventory levels and ensure timely replenishment of essential materials. • Conduct bi-weekly inventory checks for crockery and cutlery and share reports with management. 4. Training & Staff Supervision • Train, supervise, and motivate the stewarding and sanitation team, ensuring high performance and teamwork. • Organize and conduct Food Safety training sessions for tenants and pods every three months. • Provide ongoing training to staff on food safety, hygiene standards, sanitation procedures, and safety practices. • Manage stewarding team schedules and duty assignments. • Conduct performance evaluations and provide regular feedback to his team. • Manage stewarding team vacation requests and coordinate approvals with management. 5. Maintenance & Facility Coordination • Coordinate with external maintenance providers to ensure maintenance issues are addressed promptly. • Monitor and report damaged furniture, equipment issues, and operational defects. • Ensure any maintenance needs are communicated to the Ops Manager and relevant departments. • Oversee the scheduling and monitoring of pest control services and ensure presence during treatment procedures. 6. Audits, Reporting & Communication • Conduct regular cleanliness and sanitation audits for all pods and shared areas. • Monitor the condition of storage areas including vegetable rooms, dry storage, and chillers. • Provide weekly updates to the Ops Manager regarding operational issues, maintenance updates, and compliance matters. • Report operational concerns and facility requirements related to dining hall operations. Coordinate with the Ops Manager regarding cleaning materials, disposables, and operational requirements. Experience & Education – Minimum of five (5) years’ experience in similar managerial position – Certifications in HACCP Level 3 or higher, Food Safety Level 3 or higher, Fire Safety Training, First Aid Certification, and Sustainability or Environmental Management certification (such as ISO 14001 Lead Implementer / Lead Auditor or equivalent) are required or preferred Market & Industry Knowledge – Extensive market knowledge and high-value network cultivated in the GCC market – Strong knowledge of food safety regulations, hygiene standards, environmental health requirements, and sustainability practices within hospitality and F&B operations Technical & Professional Skills – Advanced verbal and written communication skills in English language – Computer advanced user of Microsoft Office applications and related operations systems – Strong understanding of HACCP systems, food safety procedures, fire safety protocols, first aid response, workplace health & safety practices, and sustainability practices in F&B environments Leadership & Personal Attributes – Great interpersonal skills and ability to lead a multinational team – Proven track record of positive achievements in the F&B industry Note: This job description reflects key duties and responsibilities of the position and is not to be interpreted as exhaustive.
